branchName.instructions:
Format: <type>/<short-kebab-case-description>.

Choose exactly one type:
- "content" for editorial or site-content changes, such as Japanese copy, images, event information, page content, or links.
- "fix" for a correction to existing behavior, layout, accessibility, or functionality that is broken or incorrect.
- "feature" for a cohesive implementation that adds new or materially expanded website functionality.

Use a concise, specific, lowercase kebab-case description. Do not use any other prefix.
